Kentucky is therefore a fast, mixed first read rather than an early-vote-only dump.
timeline.label: reference

timeline.posts_first: Early in-person and mail ballots, by law first, from 7 pm ET (Miami-Dade posts about 7:15 pm). Statewide release held to 8 pm for the Central-time panhandle.
timeline.drift: Almost none in 2024: Trump +10.7 at 8 pm (81% in), +13.3 at 9 pm, +13.1 final. In 2020 and before the early batch leaned D; in 2024 early in-person leaned R.
timeline.label: reference

timeline.posts_first: Early in-person and mail ballots returned by Monday. State law requires counties to report them within one hour of the 7 pm close. Raffensperger projected 70-75% of all votes posted by 8 pm.
timeline.drift: Toward D during the night in 2024 (Trump +10.2 at 8 pm to +2.2 final) because small counties post before metro Atlanta. The advance vote itself was near even (Trump +0.7), so the mirage was geographic, not by vote mode.
timeline.label: reference

timeline.posts_first: Towns and wards report all modes in one update; first votes 7:22 pm in 2020. Under 10% of ballots are absentee (excuse required).
timeline.drift: Blue mirage in 2024: Harris +9.4 at 8 pm (13% in), +10.1 at 9 pm, +5.0 at 11 pm, +2.8 final. Drift toward R as outlying towns post.
timeline.label: reference

timeline.posts_first: Early in-person and absentee results in the first update from nearly all 46 counties; first AP result 7:19 pm in 2024.
timeline.drift: Slight drift toward D in 2024: Trump +20.0 at 8 pm (11% in), +19.7 at 9 pm, +17.9 final. Advance vote was Trump +14.9, so Election Day was redder than early; the geographic order dominated.
timeline.label: reference

timeline.posts_first: Varies by locality. About a third of localities post all or nearly all early and absentee votes in their first update; nearly half post none in the first update (AP 2026 primary note). Rural Election Day precincts post fast.
timeline.drift: Red mirage then blue shift in 2024: Harris +7.4 at 8 pm (22% in), Trump +1.1 at 9 pm (47%), Harris +1.6 at 11 pm, Harris +4.7 at 1 am, Harris +5.8 final. Advance vote was Harris +16.1. In the 2025 governor race the first AP result came 10 minutes after close and 99%+ was in by early morning.
timeline.label: reference

timeline.posts_first: One-stop early voting and mail ballots received by 5 pm Monday, posted roughly 7:30-9 pm (NCSBE). In 2024 Mecklenburg early votes were not expected until after 10:30 pm.
timeline.drift: Depends on which counties post first. In 2024 the first 4% was Harris +5.4, by 9 pm Trump +4.4 with 36% in, then a slow drift toward D to Trump +3.2. Advance vote was Trump +0.8.
timeline.label: reference

timeline.posts_first: Early in-person and mail ballots, posted by counties right after the 7:30 pm close.
timeline.drift: Blue mirage then red shift: Harris +5.2 at 8 pm (22% in), Trump +5.9 at 9 pm, Trump +12.7 at 11 pm, final Trump +11.2.

timeline.drift: Blue mirage then red shift in 2024: Harris +5.2 at 9 pm (30% in), Trump +12.6 at 11 pm, Trump +16.1 final.

timeline.drift: Red mirage then blue shift in 2024: Harris +11.0 at 9 pm (8% in), Trump +3.8 at 11 pm, Trump +6.3 at 1 am (59%), Trump +2.1 at 7 am (95%), Trump +1.4 final. Networks called Michigan about 1 pm Wednesday (sources give 1:05 to 1:41 pm ET).

timeline.drift: Reversed from 2020-22. In 2024: near even at 11 pm (Trump +0.1 at 50% in), Trump +0.7 at 1 am, Trump +4.8 at 7 am Wednesday (60%), Trump +5.5 final. Advance vote was Trump +2.1, so the late earlies and Election Day pushed R.

rules.county: A county reading at 50 percent counted or more. Offset = the county's D minus R margin minus its our line.
rules.state_counties: The state's offset is the mean of its counties' offsets, two counties at least.
rules.pointer: Offset -2 or better: our line. Offset -5 or worse (within 2 of the Jake line, or beyond it): Jake. Between: between.
rules.statewide: At 90 percent counted the statewide offset (margin minus expected) replaces the counties, except the four special states, whose own rule applies at its own share.
rules.house_early: Each early seat at 90 percent counted: offset = margin minus our line, same pointer. Three of the five pointing one way sets the House tile. Fewer than three readings: no pointer.
rules.drift: The board's drift-adjusted line for a statewide reading before 90 percent: expected + (2024 margin at the latest 2024 checkpoint at or before that clock time - 2024 final). Shown on the board, never in a tile.
rules.no_forecast_changes: No tell changes any forecast. The tells say which frozen number the night agrees with.
